incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: DoDidDoneUi opened, but the local DDDUI backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart DoDidDoneUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: DoDidDoneUi installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so DDDUI cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest DoDidDoneUi. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined DDDUI.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest DoDidDoneUi package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined DoDidDoneUi components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: DoDidDoneUi package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This DoDidDoneUi package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: DoDidDoneUi opened, but DDDUI stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling DoDidDoneUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: DoDidDoneUi opened, but DDDUI stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling DoDidDoneUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: DoDidDoneUi opened, but DDDUI could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart DoDidDoneUi.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: DoDidDoneUi detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, DoDidDoneUi will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: DoDidDoneUi is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another DoDidDoneUi startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart DoDidDoneUi.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.
